text: Implemented renderer-neutral display window, strict transparent-band thresholding, opacity, blend modes, and colorizers in graphics with image-view compatibility aliases. Added deterministic cross-platform mesh topology identity plus exact ordered-face verification across SurfaceSet, paired geometries, sampling, and parcels. Verified graphicsJVM/JS (184 tests each), imageViewJVM/JS, and surfaceJVM/JS (96 JVM, 69 JS) in one successful sbt matrix.
